title: Debiasing Methods in Natural Language Understanding Make Bias More Accessible

bias_targets.methodology: Training an information-theoretic probing classifier on the model's inner representations to predict whether a hypothesis lexically overlaps with or is a subsequence of the premise, and measuring the extractability of this feature using Minimum Description Length (MDL).

Using a probing classifier to predict the presence of specific negative words (e.g., 'no', 'not', 'never', 'nobody') in the hypothesis or claim from the model's latent representations, and evaluating bias extractability via Minimum Description Length (MDL).
